headline: Neighborhood plan planBTV New North End, Burlington Forward update, and charter change proposals for the March 2, 2027 Annual City Meeting.
summary: Members will consider a proposed neighborhood plan and set its first public hearing for November 23, 2026. They will also discuss the Burlington Forward update and two charter change proposals.
